image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a classic car wheel. The wheel features a chrome or polished aluminum rim with a distinct raised lip and a five-spoke alloy design in the center. A black rubber tire with a white sidewall stripe (whitewall) is mounted on the rim. The central hub has a circular cap. Part of the red car body (fender) is visible at the top right, and the wheel rests on asphalt.
